zh-CN.title: 义净海上求法与归返路线骨架
zh-CN.subtitle: 从南亚学习节点到河洛归返区域的跨区域知识流动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这条路线把义净约 675 年在那烂陀的学习节点与约 695 年携经归返河洛的区域表达放入同一地图研究框架。
curatorialDescription: 地图只连接有现实地理参照的锚点，不把海上中转点或未核定的抵达城市补成事实。
番禺出发港、海路停靠点和归返后的具体译经地点继续保留在事件与研究注记中。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需继续核对番禺的港口尺度、海上航段、具体抵达城市，以及《大唐西域求法高僧传》和译经目录的版本与卷页。

value.zh-CN: 区域锚点骨架，不是完整航线
value.en: Regional-anchor skeleton, not a complete sea route

en.title: Yijing's maritime pilgrimage and return route skeleton
en.subtitle: Transregional knowledge movement from a South Asian learning node to the He-Luo return region
en.shortSummary: The route places Yijing's study at Nalanda around 675 alongside the regional expression of his return to He-Luo with scriptures around 695.
curatorialDescription: The map connects only anchors with real geographic referents and does not turn unverified maritime stops or an arrival city into facts.
The Panyu departure port, maritime stops and specific translation sites after the return remain in the events and research notes.
en.researchNote: The scale of Panyu as a port, maritime segments, the specific arrival city, and editions and folio references in the Record of Buddhist Pilgrims and translation catalogues still require verification.

value.zh-CN: 区域锚点骨架，不是完整航线
value.en: Regional-anchor skeleton, not a complete sea route

corridorNote.zh-CN: 地图只连接那烂陀学习节点与洛阳（河洛区域）可绘制锚点；番禺出发港、海上中转点和具体抵达城市尚未核定，不将两点直线当作实际航线。
corridorNote.en: The map connects only the drawable Nalanda learning node and Luoyang as a He-Luo regional anchor; the Panyu departure port, maritime stops and specific arrival city remain unverified, so the straight line between the two points is not presented as the actual sea route.
